parameters.jsCode: const h=$json.headers||{};const supplied=h['x-assis-internal-token']||h['X-Assis-Internal-Token'];if(!supplied)throw new Error('unauthorized internal memory call');const b=$json.body??$json;return [{json:{body:b,auth_endpoint:'http://n8n:5678/webhook/assis/internal/auth/verify',auth_request:{token:supplied}}}];
if($json.valid!==true)throw new Error('unauthorized internal memory call');return [{json:$node['Authorize Memory'].json.body}];

const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.conversation_id)throw new Error('conversation_id required');const allowed=['preference','profile','relationship','business_context'];const longTerm=Boolean(b.long_term);if(longTerm&&!allowed.includes(b.category))throw new Error('long-term category denied');if(longTerm&&(!b.memory_key||b.memory_value===undefined))throw new Error('memory_key and memory_value required for long-term memory');const confidence=Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(b.confidence??1),1));const namespacedKey=longTerm?`${b.category}:${String(b.memory_key).trim()}`:null;return [{json:{...b,long_term:longTerm,memory_key:namespacedKey,confidence}}];

parameters.query: WITH conv AS (SELECT organization_id,contact_id FROM conversations WHERE id=$1::uuid), short_write AS (INSERT INTO short_term_memory(conversation_id,summary,slots) VALUES($1::uuid,$2,$3::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary=EXCLUDED.summary,slots=EXCLUDED.slots,updated_at=now() RETURNING conversation_id,summary,slots,updated_at), long_write AS (INSERT INTO long_term_memory(organization_id,contact_id,memory_key,memory_value,confidence,expires_at) SELECT conv.organization_id,conv.contact_id,$4,$5::jsonb,$6,$7::timestamptz FROM conv WHERE $8::boolean AND conv.contact_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT(organization_id,contact_id,memory_key) DO UPDATE SET memory_value=EXCLUDED.memory_value,confidence=EXCLUDED.confidence,expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at,updated_at=now() RETURNING id,memory_key,memory_value,confidence,expires_at,updated_at) SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM short_write s) short_term,(SELECT row_to_json(l) FROM long_write l) long_term;
